data.name: Mym's Sword
data.detailed_description:
Solomon's Land. A desolate place, on the edge of the world. Few beasts remain there, in that last forgotten bastion of humanity. But for some, this ancient land holds the promise of adventure, both a temptation and a threat. A wandering beast discovers a magic sword, but can she uncover the truth of its origins, and resist the powers that created it?

Mym's Sword is a small puzzle platformer, action RPG, and beat-em-up hybrid. Play as Nora, a little dog with a cool sword, and discover a vast world full of colorful characters. Engage your foes in challenging combat, explore labyrinthine ruins, and collect magic rings to further enhance your power! But don't lose your head, or your blade! Ancient forces work behind the scenes, intent on stopping you from awakening a great evil, for better or worse. That which slumbers beneath the earth cannot sleep forever. Will you overcome adversity, and discover the secrets of your newfound sword?

Or will you die like the dog you are?

Features:

  • Over 300 rooms across 5 areas to discover and explore!

  • 3 devious ruins to uncover and defeat!

  • Engaging swordplay, inspired by such games as Zelda, Ys, and Tower of Druaga!

  • 25 magic rings to collect and use, each with different effects!

  • Cute yet beautiful pixel-art graphics, along with a delightful soundtrack!

  • Multiple endings!

  • Full keyboard and controller rebinding!
